name: param_default_inference
content: Infer a sensible default value for parameter '{parameter_name}' based on context.
Task: Analyze the context and determine an appropriate default value for this parameter.
"reasoning": "why this default is appropriate or why cannot infer"
- can_infer=true if you can determine a reasonable default from context
- Consider: tool purpose, user intent, urgency, operation type
- "check server" + no mentions → use common defaults
- reasoning: explain why this default makes sense
If you cannot confidently infer a default, set can_infer=false.

variables.name: parameter_name
variables.description: The technical name of the parameter

variables.name: description
variables.description: Description of what this parameter controls
examples: Maximum time to wait for response

variables.name: user_message
variables.description: The user's original message or request

variables.name: context_info
variables.description: Additional context including tool purpose, known parameters, and hints
examples:
Tool: network_diagnostics
Tool Purpose: Check network connectivity

Already Known Parameters:
- target: google.com

Inference Hints:
- Use fast timeouts for health checks

metadata.description: Infers context-aware default values for parameters based on tool purpose, user intent, and urgency
metadata.author: MagicianV2-ProgressiveElicitation
metadata.changelog: Initial version for Phase 2.1 LLM-based defaults
